# Chimera-lab - README Documents Syntax Rules

These rules should be applied to every README document present on the organization. It create a patter that can be easily understood.

## Documents Headers

### :world\_map: Guides

### :gear: Guide Steps

### :notebook: Notes

### :books: References

### :newspaper: Sources

### :hammer\_and\_wrench: Common problems

### :link: See also

### :medal_military: Credits
